experiment: One finite task-complement O rotation with nonlinear MLP compensation

AGA.sha256_scope: UTF-8 text with universal newline normalization, as existing author loader

construction_access: Frozen target/public base,existing originalAGA and weight-only task SVD. No real images,classification heads,partners,confirmation/test scores or prior candidate weights.
finite_mechanism: For every orthogonal R and ridge eta>0,F_eta(XR)=F_eta(X),including eta1e-8. Rotate only O,not V;native Attention and subsequent LN2/QuickGELU change. B jointly compensates native complete unit features while actual originalAGA removes O rotation and transports B with unchanged A permutation. Verify actual author FP32 result after freeze.
parameterization: For each head,P projects off the corresponding rows of O task right basis. R0=I-2P maximizes finite O task-complement distance in this orthogonal family. R=R0 exp(P(Z-Z^T)P),O_prime=O R. B_delta is constrained to V_B complement. Both task-action changes zero in exact arithmetic.
difference_from_closed_game: This is a finite recovery-invariant parameter family throughout optimization,not another initialization of the unconstrained59be game. Old within-head V/O gauge changed V inversely;here V fixed and native computation changes. Temperature,normal-space game,old fixed reflections and real-data fit points remain closed.
initialization: One B ridge solve on1024 generated pixel inputs with actual rotated O/LN2 and frozen teacher complete block outputs;fixed .01 mean-diagonal damping. Project once to declared B<=4 if necessary,report unconstrained norm. Never reads real images.
objective: 1000*mean native complete unit-feature squared error - mean recovered complete unit-feature squared error - .01*sum squared relative O/B distances. Standard Adam in finite orthogonal coordinates and B task complement;two generated-pixel ascent steps maximize native discrepancy with teacher input derivative retained.
bounds: O relative Frobenius<=2 follows from orthogonality;B<=4 prospectively declared,combined<=sqrt20. Historical D.5 and strictR.5 retained separately,not claimed met by this range.
sole_point: Save only final512th iterate and content SHA before new128 synthetic inputs. No best-checkpoint selection,angle/rank/layer/seed/loss/steps tuning or restarting this fixed point.
evaluation: Then once full10000MNIST standalone with strictR and actual accuracy both. If accuracy loss<=.5pp,run fixed TA.5 and unchanged originalAGA target-only/both with SVHN;reuse unprotected states/scores,report both tasks/perclass/paired/cost and original128-context replay. If not,close with evidence,no repair.
limitations: Generic rotations,SVD,adversarial distillation,ridge and minmax are known. Finite O erasure does not prove B compensation or classification harm. Generated pixels do not certify natural-task coverage. Novelty and efficacy unestablished;no new effective defense claimed.
